description: an ellipse of major radius 2 along (0.8, 0.6) and minor radius 1, centred 5 from the axis in the xz plane, revolved a full turn about z: Open CASCADE builds the elliptic torus, Arris refuses it with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::EllipticRevolve naming loop 0, segment 0, since a surface of revolution with an elliptic meridian has no variant and the meridian arm has no ellipse section (ADR-0014). Volume 2*pi*R * pi*a*b by Pappus; the centroid sits above the section's centre by cu*cv*(a^2 - b^2)/(4R), the tilted section's second moments weighted by rho, and the area has no closed form
